author: JeTePardonne
body:
Age: 16 (will be 17 on March 19)
Timezone: Pacific 
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes 
Do you have access to Skype? Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?

I am currently a referee on this server, but I have not had any other experience on any other servers.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

My biggest weakness that has impacted me with my everyday life and I believe it will affect my moderating is I am an easygoing person. This may tend to make me a bit lenient if it came down to giving an infraction. As time goes on I learn more and more on how to step out of my comfort zone and to not let people either abuse how easy going I am, or I make myself versatile and have the ability to be both firm and easygoing when either one is necessary. I am also open to any constructive criticism and ways to help me improve on this even more, I am always looking for ways to improve. I also have the tendency to become nervous when put on the spot, but that is also another thing I am very open to for ways to help and change. My biggest strength that would affect my moderating is I am an open-minded person. I never just choose one side and stick with it one-hundred percent without considering the other option, I always listen and am welcome to new ideas. This would help me be understanding when it came to any situation that it would be needed, such as appeals. I also will not be biased towards anyone in anyway, if they deserve the infraction, they will receive it. I also truly love this server and am not interested in moderating because it looks "cool", but to help the server in any way possible. I also am open to any type of discussion, and enjoy debating about topics need to reach a result. I also am a very loyal person, and do not give up easily at any given time. 

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

One of the issues that the community has pointed out is that there is not enough staff on when needed. I could help this issue, since I am a very active member of the community. There are multiple times when I am online at night, that there are no mods on. I am currently second place on the most time spent on Avicus, with a total of three months, soon to be four. I play almost every night, and this could be essential since due to my timezone there sometimes are not any mods online to ban hackers, or give out the needed punishments. Also, I have played soccer ever since I was four, which is about 12-13 years now. Soccer is a team sport and requires a lot of teamwork, communication, and sometimes even the ability to take constructive criticism. Staff constantly receives criticism from the community, so if someone were to let me know I was doing something poorly or tell me a way to improve, I would not ignore or just believe they're wrong, I would reevaluate myself and take the criticism seriously, and hopefully improve from it. I have adapted and gained these certain skills, which I will be able to have, use, and bring if I was apart of the staff team. Also, the pregame tactics that are used for the soccer match, can also be helpful when listening to staff plans and executing them properly. I am also enrolled in a full IB schedule in High school currently, which is equivalent to AP. So, I have already learned how to properly manage time and how to find a balance. These classes also require critical thinking, which I can also use and bring if I was apart of the staff team. In addition, these classes have also helped me understand how to have trust in your peers when performing group tasks, and how sometimes your idea/topic is not always the best way to go, which is equivalent to being open-minded to other people's ideas and topics. I am also a good listener, and I will help both the staff team and community when it is needed. 

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

In my opinion, it is important for a leader to have confidence, decisiveness, and communication skills. It is important for a leader to be confident, because their confidence is contagious to their employees. Of course decisiveness is important too, since leaders constantly have to make difficult decisions. Communication is key, because if the leader can not get his or her point across properly, it can either be misinterpreted or possible even ignored. I do consider myself a leader, because I have the qualities needed, and I am currently a leader of an Avicus team as well as being in a mentoring program at school where we get assigned freshmen and become their "leaders" for the year. Not only does this make us step out of our comfort zone, but it teaches us leadership skills that can easily be translated into moderating. 

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

A few attributes that distinguish myself from other players on this server are; my comfortability with the community, I am a talkative person, and I stay out of trouble on the server. I enjoy making new friends on the server, and never hesitate to add them on to my team. I have had teammates on my team who did not have a forums account before I talked to them in game, but after a while of being friends I convinced them to make a forum account to join the team to play scrim servers. I love talking to new people on the server and making new friends, especially since kindness is the easiest gift to give to people. I always stay out of trouble and drama with my peers and enjoy giving positive feedback on player's forum posts. I am also active on all three platforms, and I enjoy browsing the forums on my free-time, especially in school. Also, I am already a ref and am in the discord, I kinda understand what it is like being a mod, not completely, but I have been exposed to it.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

The communication between the staff team and the community always has room for improvement, and recently there have been a lot of complaints and people saying that the staff team does not listen. This is not the case at all, but this is just a sign that the communication between the two definitely can be improved. The community just wants to know that they have been heard, and understood. Myself as an individual has been apart of the community for over three years and have seen the worse times and the best times, can communicate with them more because I know what it feels like to be in their shoes for a long time. Sometimes we just need to hear that we are being listened to, because we clearly are, it is just hard to tell. I get along with both the staff and the community very well, and I will be able to help bring the two together. 

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 

A rough estimation would be multiple hours per day, and on the weekends I could for even longer if needed. 

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

Well, since I am only a junior mod and I am not able to ban, I would record the hacker and after I received enough evidence I would freeze them, and send the evidence to a mod or senior mod who could come online on minechat. If no one is able to come on minechat or ban them in any other way, I would keep freezing them until they hopefully would leave. 

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

First, I would ask them to stop or knock it off before the situation gets more out of hand. If the staff member continues their behavior I would move them out of the room and privately discuss the possible outcome if the situation continued. From then on if they continue, I will punish them accordingly and if needed contact a staff member of higher rank.

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?

I would discuss the situation with someone with a higher rank in the staff team who may know the proper way to execute the situation. If worse comes to worse and the player would be able to get unbanned, I would keep an eye out for them and inform my other fellow staff members about the individual and to not take any reports against him or her lightly. 

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

If it was information that was suppose to be only for the staff team's eyes I would contact a sr mod or admin, because if the individual really cared about their staff position, and was a good teammate, they would not put himself, the team, and myself in a position such as that. If he would do it to a screenshot of something on the forums, and I let him slide, he may do it again with a more valuable piece of information and expect me to not respond and report him. 

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

First, before I put any type of input about the decision made, I would ask a senior mod to elaborate with me about the decision. After I received information and I have an understanding of the decision, if my opinion still remains the same I would let it be heard. I  would not force it to be acknowledged nor have it be applied, I would just want to give my own opinion and to see if it changes anything.  

CRITERIA 3: OTHER

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?  

Finally being able to be promoted as a moderator on Avicus would mean an abundance to me. Like previously stated, I have played on this server for three years and I have not done much to contribute to the server. I've had friends on the server tell me to apply for moderator or any type of staff in general, but I have never tried since my infractions kept adding up. After the last temp-banned I received for caps, it was almost like a wake up call for me. It made me realize as a 16 year old, I should not be acting like a child and misbehave so much on a Minecraft server. Since then I have decided to act my age and mature. I took all my infractions to heart and decided it was time to change. I have not received an infraction since, and I carried out with my wish for contributing to the server by applying for ref, and getting accepted. I have always had the desire to become a mod, and I have finally gained the confidence and courage into doing so. I want to change my repute, and instead of being a nuisance, I want to give all that I can to this server, since it has done so much for me. 

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

Avicus for the longest time was the only server I played on. When I first began to play Minecraft and found out about Mczone, I would only come on Minecraft to play Walls on this server. Another alternative I had was Mineplex, but I always chose Mczone over Mineplex. I was only about 12 and it was really hard for me to navigate the internet, so I did not know how to find good servers. Therefore, when I discovered this server and I enjoyed it, I did not bother looking for any other one. I remember when Mczone shut down for a while for whatever reason I do not recall, I stopped playing Minecraft on pc for a while since I could not log in. A few months later I log back on to see the server was back up and began playing again. I have put a lot of time into playing on this server, and have been here for a long time, even through the hard times and great times, and I still do not have the desire to leave Avicus anytime soon.

Do you speak any other languages than English?

I speak English and Spanish to a certain extent. I can understand it when it is being spoken and typed out, but my own speaking skills have plenty of room for improvement. I also understand Greek. 

Do you have anything else to add to your application?

I just wanted to give a little bit of information about myself :)

My name is Tobin, but my friends call my Ashley. I am a female and am currently finishing my 11th year of High school in June. I love soccer way more than I probably should, and I love helping people in any way I can.

I hope you consider me for this position

-Tobin (DebsThePebs) - New ign Ephesians
